quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed.

explanation.bs: „Allah naređuje pravdu i dobročinstvo“ – Allahova naredba.
explanation.en: “Allah enjoineth justice and kindness” — Allah's command.

quranTranslation.text: And when Moses said unto his people: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye sacrifice a cow, they said: Dost thou make game of us? He answered: Allah forbid that I should be among the foolish!

explanation.bs: „Allah vam zaista naređuje da zakoljete jednu kravu“ – jasna, određena naredba.
explanation.en: “Allah commandeth you that ye sacrifice a cow” — a plain, specific command.

quranTranslation.text: And when they do some lewdness they say: We found our fathers doing it and Allah hath enjoined it on us. Say: Allah, verily, enjoineth not lewdness. Tell ye concerning Allah that which ye know not?

explanation.bs: „Allah, zaista, ne naređuje razvrat“ – أَمَرَ o onome što ljudi pogrešno pripisuju Allahu.
explanation.en: “Allah, verily, enjoineth not lewdness” — أَمَرَ of what people wrongly ascribe to Allah.

quranTranslation.text: The same did Abraham enjoin upon his sons, and also Jacob, (saying): O my sons! Lo! Allah hath chosen for you the (true) religion; therefore die not save as men who have surrendered (unto Him).

explanation.bs: Ibrahim je to oporučio sinovima svojim, i Jakub – vjera predana u amanet.
explanation.en: Abraham instructed his sons with it, and so did Jacob — faith handed on in trust.

quranTranslation.text: We have enjoined on man kindness to parents; but if they strive to make thee join with Me that of which thou hast no knowledge, then obey them not. Unto Me is your return and I shall tell you what ye used to do.

explanation.bs: „Oporučili smo čovjeku dobročinstvo prema roditeljima“ – trajna preporuka.
explanation.en: “We have enjoined on man kindness to parents” — a lasting charge.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Come, I will recite unto you that which your Lord hath made a sacred duty for you: That ye ascribe no thing as partner unto Him and that ye do good to parents, and that ye slay not your children because of penury - We provide for you and for them - and that ye draw not nigh to lewd things whether open or concealed. And that ye slay not the life which Allah hath made sacred, save in the course of justice. This He hath command you, in order that ye may discern.

explanation.bs: Nakon niza zapovijedi i zabrana: „Eto, to vam On nalaže“ – sažetak uz brigu i savjet.
explanation.en: After a series of commands and prohibitions: “This He hath command[ed] you” — a summary given with care and counsel.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Strong drink and games of chance and idols and divining arrows are only an infamy of Satan's handiwork. Leave it aside in order that ye may succeed.

explanation.bs: „Vino, kocka, kameni kipovi i strelice za gatanje samo su gadost od šejtanova djela; zato se toga klonite.“ – ar-Rāġib: gadost po šerijatu.
explanation.en: “Strong drink and games of chance and idols and divining arrows are only an infamy (رِجْسٌ) of Satan's handiwork. Leave it aside” — ar-Rāġib: defilement by the Sharia.

quranTranslation.text: Say: I find not in that which is revealed unto me aught prohibited to an eater that he eat thereof, except it be carrion, or blood poured forth, or swineflesh - for that verily is foul - or the abomination which was immolated to the name of other than Allah. But whoso is compelled (thereto), neither craving nor transgressing, (for him) lo! thy Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „…ili svinjsko meso – jer je ono zaista gadost“ – ar-Rāġib: po šerijatu.
explanation.en: “…or swineflesh - for that verily is foul (رِجْسٌ)” — ar-Rāġib: by the Sharia.

quranTranslation.text: But as for those in whose hearts is disease, it only addeth wickedness to their wickedness, and they die while they are disbelievers.

explanation.bs: „A one čija su srca bolesna – njima ona samo dodaje gadost na gadost njihovu“ – ar-Rāġib: nevjerovanje kao gadost razumu.
explanation.en: “But as for those in whose hearts is disease, it only addeth wickedness (رِجْسًا) to their wickedness” — ar-Rāġib: unbelief as defilement to reason.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! The idolaters only are unclean. So let them not come near the Inviolable Place of Worship after this their year. If ye fear poverty (from the loss of their merchandise) Allah shall preserve you of His bounty if He will. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.

explanation.bs: „O vi koji vjerujete, mnogobošci su samo nečisti, pa neka se ne približavaju Svetom mesdžidu“ – ar-Rāġib to shvaća kao nečistoću koja se opaža pronicljivošću; učenjaci se razilaze koliko ona seže.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! The idolaters only are unclean. So let them not come near the Inviolable Place of Worship” — ar-Rāġib takes it as an uncleanness perceived by insight; scholars differ on how far it reaches.

quranTranslation.text: And if Allah were to enlarge the provision for His slaves they would surely rebel in the earth, but He sendeth down by measure as He willeth. Lo! He is Informed, a Seer of His bondmen.

explanation.bs: „A da Allah proširi (بَسَطَ) opskrbu Svojim robovima, oni bi se na Zemlji osilili“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, učinio je obilnom.
explanation.en: “And if Allah were to enlarge (بَسَطَ) the provision for His slaves they would surely rebel in the earth” — according to ar-Rāġib, made it ample.

gloss.en: to spread out, to reach out, to widen

quranTranslation.text: Even if thou stretch out thy hand against me to kill me, I shall not stretch out my hand against thee to kill thee, lo! I fear Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.

explanation.bs: Ademov sin bratu: „Ako ti pružiš (بَسَطْتَ) prema meni svoju ruku da me ubiješ, ja svoju ruku neću pružiti prema tebi“ – pružiti ruku za napad.
explanation.en: Adam's son to his brother: “Even if thou stretch out (بَسَطْتَ) thy hand against me to kill me, I shall not stretch out my hand against thee” — the hand reached out to attack.

gloss.en: to spread out, to reach out, to widen

quranTranslation.text: Allah is He Who sendeth the winds so that they raise clouds, and spreadeth them along the sky as pleaseth Him, and causeth them to break and thou seest the rain downpouring from within them. And when He maketh it to fall on whom He will of His bondmen, lo! they rejoice;

explanation.bs: „Allah je Onaj Koji šalje vjetrove, pa oni pokreću oblake, i On ih rasprostire (يَبْسُطُ) po nebu kako hoće“ – širenje u širinu.
explanation.en: “Allah is He Who sendeth the winds so that they raise clouds, and spreadeth them (يَبْسُطُ) along the sky as pleaseth Him” — spreading in breadth.

gloss.en: to spread out, to reach out, to widen

quranTranslation.text: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread the shade - And if He willed He could have made it still - then We have made the sun its pilot;

explanation.bs: „Zar ne vidiš kako je tvoj Gospodar protegao (مَدَّ) sjenu“ – izvlačenje u dužinu; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread [drawn out] (مَدَّ) the shade” — drawing out in length; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And He it is Who spread out the earth and placed therein firm hills and flowing streams, and of all fruits He placed therein two spouses (male and female). He covereth the night with the day. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought.

explanation.bs: „On je Taj Koji je protegao (مَدَّ) Zemlju i na njoj postavio čvrsto usađena brda i rijeke.“
explanation.en: “And He it is Who spread out [stretched out] (مَدَّ) the earth and placed therein firm hills and flowing streams.”

quranTranslation.text: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.

explanation.bs: „…i produžit ćemo (نَمُدُّ) mu kaznu“ – prema ar-Rāġibu, مَدَّ o onome što je mrsko.
explanation.en: “… and prolong (نَمُدُّ) for him a span of torment” — according to ar-Rāġib, مَدَّ of what is disliked.

quranTranslation.text: He it is Who created you from dust, then from a drop (of seed) then from a clot, then bringeth you forth as a child, then (ordaineth) that ye attain full strength and afterward that ye become old men - though some among you die before - and that ye reach an appointed term, that haply ye may understand.

explanation.bs: „On je Onaj Koji vas je stvorio od zemlje, potom od kapi sjemena, potom od ugruška, a zatim vas izvodi kao dijete“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “He it is Who created you from dust, then from a drop (of seed) then from a clot, then bringeth you forth as a child” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: O mankind! if ye are in doubt concerning the Resurrection, then lo! We have created you from dust, then from a drop of seed, then from a clot, then from a little lump of flesh shapely and shapeless, that We may make (it) clear for you. And We cause what We will to remain in the wombs for an appointed time, and afterward We bring you forth as infants, then (give you growth) that ye attain your full strength. And among you there is he who dieth (young), and among you there is he who is brought back to the most abject time of life, so that, after knowledge, he knoweth naught. And thou (Muhammad) seest the earth barren, but when We send down water thereon, it doth thrill and swell and put forth every lovely kind (of growth).

explanation.bs: „… onda vas kao dijete izvodimo, a potom da biste dosegli punu snagu svoju“ – ista slika rođenja.
explanation.en: “… afterward We bring you forth as infants, then (give you growth) that ye attain your full strength” — the same picture of birth.

quranTranslation.text: And when the children among you come to puberty then let them ask leave even as those before them used to ask it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise.

explanation.bs: „A kad djeca među vama dostignu spolnu zrelost, neka traže dozvolu“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet za množinu.
explanation.en: “And when the children among you come to puberty then let them ask leave” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah for the plural.

quranTranslation.text: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child,

explanation.bs: „O Jahja, uzmi Knjigu svom snagom!“ – i dadosmo mu mudrost (ḥukm) još kao nedoraslom.
explanation.en: “O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom [ḥukm] when a child [ṣabiyyan: while yet a youngster].”

quranTranslation.text: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?

explanation.bs: Merjem pokaza na njega, a oni rekoše: „Kako da govorimo onome ko je u bešici, nedorastao?“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Mary pointed to him; they said: “How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him).

explanation.bs: „O Zekerijja, Mi te radujemo viješću o dječaku čije je ime Jahja.“
explanation.en: “O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son [ġulām: a boy] whose name is John.”

quranTranslation.text: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.

explanation.bs: „Pa smo ga obradovali blagim dječakom“ – Ibrahima.
explanation.en: “So We gave him tidings of a gentle son [ġulām: a boy]” — Abraham.

quranTranslation.text: And there came a caravan, and they sent their waterdrawer. He let down his pail (into the pit). He said: Good luck! Here is a youth. And they hid him as a treasure, and Allah was Aware of what they did.

explanation.bs: Kad je onaj koji je zahvatao vodu spustio vedro: „O radosti, evo dječaka!“ – Jusuf; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: When their water-drawer let down his pail: “Good luck! Here is a youth” — Joseph; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
